summary: Clarifies when Node-ID based RSVP Hello messages are used. Their use is implied in cases such as when data and control planes are separated or when traffic engineering links are unnumbered, and when failure detection happens by other means. It is a standards-track clarification.

eli5.summary: Two routers send short hello messages to check each other is still there. This explains which address the hellos should be sent to and from, so the check works in tricky setups.
